kind: maintainer installation smoke test, not an external usability study

checks.stdout:
usage: __main__.py [-h] [--db DB] [--family FAMILY] [--model MODEL]
                   [--revision REVISION]
                   {demo,add,recall,pack,get,invalidate,forget,observe,explain,select,fit,serve} ...

Local context fingerprints and evidence selection

positional arguments:
  {demo,add,recall,pack,get,invalidate,forget,observe,explain,select,fit,serve}
    demo                run without a database or model download
    add                 store one text chunk; use stable source IDs
    observe             observe only explicitly listed files under a trusted
                        root
    explain             explain changed or missing source versions
    select              select evidence with freshness and required-source
                        guards
    fit                 fit a projection on a training-only NumPy embedding
                        matrix
    serve               serve local read tools over MCP stdio

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --db DB               SQLite store (default: context.sqlite)
  --family FAMILY       projection family JSON; required only when creating a
                        trained store
  --model MODEL         optional sentence-transformers model identifier
  --revision REVISION   immutable model commit SHA

limitations: one Windows host; network download time is included; no human participant results
